packageRules.description: @playwright/test is pinned to match the Chromium browser revision installed in CI and local dev. Updating requires verifying that the new version's expected browser revision is available. See: ~/.cache/ms-playwright/ for installed revisions.
Keep next and @next/mdx (and other @next/* packages) on the same version — they are released in lockstep and must stay aligned.
Keep @mdx-js/* aligned with @next/mdx — @next/mdx pins a peer range on these, so update them together to avoid peer-dep drift.
